name: Spiritual Families
overview: Scripture reveals that spiritual families extend beyond natural relationships, as Jesus' own mother and brothers sought to speak with Him, highlighting the importance of both biological and spiritual bonds. Believers are called to be part of the household of God, no longer strangers but fellow citizens with the saints, emphasizing unity and belonging in Christ. At the same time, the Bible upholds the authority and respect within natural families, instructing children to obey their parents as this pleases the Lord, showing that spiritual and natural family roles coexist under God's design.
